findings.detail: An earlier exact Office-update admission scenario left its accepted run queued, so the next independent scenario correctly rejected a second active run.
findings.fix: Cancel the accepted queued run through the ordinary human command before leaving its scenario.

findings.detail: Adding the privileged subscription-manager role requires actual MFA authentication.
findings.fix: Acquire a real fixture MFA human session after role installation.

findings.detail: System administrator does not grant ordinary finance FX-policy management.
findings.fix: Bind the ordinary finance_fx_manager role to the human financial actor and publish with that MFA session.

findings.detail: Shared plan/decision trigger referenced a decision-only NEW field inside one combined condition.
findings.fix: Resolve decision-only fields only inside the explicit decision-table branch; capture unexpected fixture diagnostics.

findings.detail: Malformed ready/expiry dates must fail closed instead of relying on NaN comparisons.
findings.fix: Validate all three observation timestamps and add malformed-clock assertions to the existing shared case.
